seoTitle: Which Modern Family Character Are You? Modern Family Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Modern Family test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Phil, Claire, Jay, Gloria, Mitchell, Cam, Haley or Alex — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the dad who thinks he's the cool dad, the mom holding the whole family together, or the grandpa who just wants some peace and quiet? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle family, friends and everyday chaos, and find out which Modern Family character you are.

characters.name: Phil Dunphy
characters.title: The Cool Dad (He Thinks)
characters.summary: Endlessly upbeat, a little goofy and genuinely sweet. You think you're the cool one — and honestly, sometimes you are.
description: Like Phil, you see the best in everything and everyone. He's a real estate agent who could sell anybody a house, mostly because he's so enthusiastic about it.
You've got hobbies. So many hobbies. Phil loves magic tricks, gadgets and his own life philosophy, and he was a college cheerleader — which he'll mention.
You might embarrass your family, but they'd never want you any other way.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to be liked that you sometimes miss what's actually going on.
characters.signature: A magic trick nobody asked for and a proud "Phil's-osophy".
characters.clashReason: they'd make terrible jokes and be proud of them

characters.name: Claire Dunphy
characters.title: The Controlled Chaos Manager
characters.summary: Organised, competitive and quietly running everything. Nothing happens in this family without you knowing about it.
description: Like Claire, you're the one holding it all together. Three kids, a husband who is basically a fourth kid, and a plan for every situation.
You're competitive — very competitive — and you were a wild one when you were younger, even if you'd rather nobody mentioned it.
You're ambitious, too. Claire went from stay-at-home mom to running her father's closet company, and she proved she could do it.
characters.flaw: You need control so badly that you struggle to just let things happen.
characters.signature: A schedule, a firm voice and the one look that stops everyone in their tracks.
characters.clashReason: they have to win at everything

characters.name: Jay Pritchett
characters.title: The Gruff Patriarch
characters.summary: Old-school, blunt and not a big talker about feelings. But when it counts, you show up for your family.
description: Like Jay, you built something. He started his own closet business and he's proud of it — rightly so.
You're not great at feelings. You'd rather give someone a gruff nod than a speech. But you love your family, and you're softer than you let on — especially with your dog, Stella.
You just want a little peace and quiet. You rarely get it.
characters.flaw: You can be stubborn and a bit stuck in your ways.
characters.signature: A recliner, a quiet afternoon and a small dog who's clearly the favourite.
characters.clashReason: they'd never want to talk about feelings

characters.name: Gloria Pritchett
characters.title: The Fierce Force of Nature
characters.summary: Passionate, loud and fiercely protective. You say exactly what you think — and you're usually right.
description: Like Gloria, you're big energy. You feel things strongly and you don't hide it, whether it's joy, anger or love.
You're fiercely protective of your family. Gloria would do anything for Manny and Joe, and heaven help anyone who comes after them.
People underestimate you. That's their mistake — you're sharper and tougher than anyone expects.
characters.flaw: Your temper is quick, and you can be very, very dramatic.
characters.signature: A big entrance, a big laugh and a threat nobody's sure is a joke.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what they think. Loudly

characters.name: Mitchell Pritchett
characters.title: The Anxious Overthinker
characters.summary: Smart, responsible and a little tightly wound. You worry so everybody else doesn't have to.
description: Like Mitchell, you're the sensible one. He's a lawyer, and he approaches life like a case: careful, logical and prepared for every worst outcome.
You're dry and quietly funny, and you're the calm (well, calmer) half of any partnership — especially next to a big personality.
You'd rather avoid a scene. Unfortunately, scenes seem to find you.
characters.flaw: You overthink everything and struggle to relax.
characters.signature: A careful sigh, a sensible plan and a partner doing the exact opposite.

characters.name: Cam Tucker
characters.title: The Big-Hearted Showman
characters.summary: Dramatic, warm and full of surprises. Every moment is an event, and every event needs a theme.
description: Like Cam, you were born for the spotlight. He's been a clown (Fizbo!), a music teacher and a football coach — and he brings the same big energy to all of them.
You feel everything in capital letters. When you're happy, the whole room knows. When you're upset, the whole block knows.
But you're the warmest person in any room, and your friends and family always know how loved they are.
characters.flaw: You make everything about the moment — and occasionally about you.
characters.signature: A grand gesture, a costume change and a speech with a dramatic pause.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every little thing into a big production

characters.name: Haley Dunphy
characters.title: The Social Butterfly
characters.summary: Fun, stylish and smarter about people than anyone gives you credit for. School was never your thing — life is.
description: Like Haley, you know people. You might not ace exams, but you can read a room, pick an outfit and handle a social situation better than anyone in your family.
You had a messy start figuring out what you wanted. Haley did too — and she found her own path her own way.
You're more thoughtful than you look, and you're fiercely protective of your siblings, even if you'd never admit it.
characters.flaw: You can be a bit self-absorbed and avoid anything that feels like work.
characters.signature: A phone in hand, a perfect outfit and a comeback for her little sister.

characters.name: Alex Dunphy
characters.title: The Sarcastic Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, driven and dry as a desert. You're the smartest person in the room, and slightly exhausted by everyone else.
description: Like Alex, you work hard and it shows. Top grades, big ambitions, and a place at Caltech.
Your sense of humour is sharp and sarcastic. You're often the only person noticing how ridiculous everyone is being.
Underneath, you feel more than you let on. You just wish people saw you for more than your brain.
characters.flaw: You put so much pressure on yourself that you forget to have fun.
characters.signature: A stack of books, a perfect report card and an eye-roll.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you feel like the least clever person in the room

questions.text: You're in charge of planning a family trip. You...

options.text: Plan every hour. Colour-coded
Plan the fun bits. Someone else can do the boring stuff
Pay for it, then complain about the price the whole time
Pack three suitcases. For a weekend

questions.text: Someone insults your family at a party. You...

options.text: Get in their face. Nobody talks about your family like that
Deliver a speech the whole party will remember
Say something cutting and walk away
Try to smooth it over before there's a scene

questions.text: You get a whole Saturday to yourself. You...

options.text: Recliner, a quiet house and nobody asking for anything
Brunch and shopping with friends
Get ahead on work. It's relaxing, honestly
The salon, then dancing all night

questions.text: A family board game gets heated. You...

options.text: Play to win. Winning is the only thing
Enjoy it. You're just happy everyone's together
You'll win. You've already done the maths
Accuse someone of cheating. Loudly

questions.text: You're helping a kid with their homework, and they keep getting it wrong. You...

options.text: Make a study plan on the spot
Tell them it's fine, then turn it into a game
"Just do it again." That's the whole lesson
Worry that you're the one explaining it wrong

questions.text: You take up a new hobby. It's...

options.text: Magic. You've got a whole act
Fashion blogging. You've already got the followers
Golf. And you don't want tips
Anything competitive. You'll be winning by week two

questions.text: Someone asks you for life advice. You give them...

options.text: A carefully weighed list of pros and cons
A big, dramatic pep talk
Your own personal life philosophy
The brutal truth, with love

questions.text: You and your partner have a big argument. You...

options.text: Talk it through calmly — and a little passive-aggressively
Tears, a slammed door and a big making-up
Calmly point out exactly where their logic falls apart
Be right. Then wait for them to come around

questions.text: You're asked to give a speech at a big family birthday. It's...

options.text: Twenty minutes long, with a slideshow and a song
Clever — possibly too clever for the room
Short, gruff, and somehow the one that makes everyone cry
Totally unprepared, and somehow perfect

questions.text: You're looking after a friend's teenager for the weekend, and they want to go to a party. You...

options.text: Say no. Then drive past the party anyway, just to check
Say yes, then try to be the cool adult at pickup
Absolutely not. There is no discussion
Turn it into a big, emotional heart-to-heart

questions.text: At family dinner, your brother and his partner announce they're adopting a baby. You...

options.text: Volunteer to babysit. For money
Start a list of everything they're going to need
Say something gruff but supportive, then change the subject
Plan the christening on the spot

questions.text: Your dad marries someone much younger than him. At the wedding, you...

options.text: Worry it's a midlife crisis — then smile for every photo anyway
Ask where they got that dress
Quietly look up the statistics on age-gap marriages
Cry harder than anyone at the ceremony
